snippet.title: [Chasing KaleidoRIDER] Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
#ChasingKaleidorider #KaleidoRIDER

"Hysteria," born from humanity's negative consciousness, have invaded reality, causing large-scale anomalies in "Terminus."
Fortunately, mysterious super-powered girls riding motorbikes bravely battle against them and are known as—Kaleido RIDER.
They search for traces of the "Navigator" throughout the city, hoping to obtain the power of "KALEIDO VISION."

"Found you, Navigator."

————————————
The heart-racing RPG featuring RIDER biker babes—[Chasing Kaleidorider] Announcement Trailer officially releases!
PV Theme Song: Chase! Kaleido!
Vocals: 96Neko
Produced by: Fizzglee Studio
Visit the official website now to pre-register and get more official information!
[Chasing Kaleidorider] Official Website: https://kaleidorider.com
[Chasing Kaleidorider] Official X: https://x.com/KaleidoRIDER_EN
Fizzglee Studio Official X: https://x.com/FizzgleeStudio
